notes.title: The Killer Walkthrough Part 3
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome back, fearless gamers![/b] 🎮 

After surviving the horrors of the last chapter, it’s time to dive deeper into the story of The Killer! 🕵️‍♂️



[b]1. Back to normal?[/b]

It looks like we’re back at our desk. 🖥️ Read the note on the table, pick up the assignment card, and press “i” to read the pending tasks. 📋
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134490/456d9521eca2fe76e2f3fd305da86f8737f9ee71.gif[/img]


[b]2. Strange task.[/b]

Go to the bathroom 🚻 and turn off the lights, then come back and swipe your card. 💳
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134490/1adc859ca3b2ecbddcc529eb37e30dfb3a1384d6.gif[/img]


[b]3. Why is this happening?[/b]

I clearly turned off the lights… 😕 Alright, go to the bathroom again and turn off the lights, then come back and swipe your card. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134490/345455dc5dc1d0fd7d675c806a0472208cff2b09.gif[/img]


[b]4. Impossible task.[/b]

Turn off the lights one more time, and when you come back, a table appears in front of the Check machine. 🕵️‍♀️ Follow the instructions in the letter and press the button. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134490/cf6b6f8bf19be897b23fa35b160f5d23d451d898.gif[/img]


[b]5. Did I get rid of the bad guy?[/b]

The office door opens.🚪 Go through that door and keep walking until you reach the cliff, then push the bad guy off the edge. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134490/1c5cfe891a3ff7ed88f0e839b87b1b85c6b5ba3d.gif[/img]



[b]Enjoy the game![/b] 🎉 

If you have any feedback, feel free to reach out to us anytime. 📧 
Thank you!

notes.title: The Killer Walkthrough Part 2
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome back, brave adventurer!👋 [/b]

Ready to face more thrilling challenges? 🎯Let’s continue exploring this world full of unknown horrors! 👻



[b]1.More agile than a mouse.🐭[/b] 

From Room 4, pass through Room 3 and Room 2. Insert the lever in Room 2 to enter Room 1. 🗝️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134490/3a9a36d74f15888c7bc7fa56cda5ce0315f82e61.gif[/img]


[b]2.A key! Is it for the door to freedom?🚪[/b] 

Obtain the key from the balance scale⚖️ in Room 4 and use it to open the door. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134490/39251308174a8eb76fc32e97a9f9d7eae1908660.gif[/img]


[b]3.Escape![/b] 🏃‍♂️ 

The cell door is open, but the alarm is sounding. 🚨 Run! Turn left after exiting and hide in the wardrobe in the front room. 🚪
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134490/b116886ec1d7e97e3b349f21405b30531b118913.gif[/img]


[b]4.A letter for me.[/b] ✉️ 

It seems we have no choice. Press the button and enter the sewer. 🕳️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134490/d8dde8376f59168c6aa7e14ab39e75dcddf0d010.gif[/img]


[b]5.A path to freedom?[/b] 🌄

The door is open, run out! Head towards the light in the tunnel. 🌟
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134490/695bbd3af2774f6e8abd8920e63beee0b032bbb3.gif[/img]



[b]Stay tuned for more parts coming soon![/b]  

If you have any feedback, feel free to reach out to us anytime. 📧 
Thank you!

notes.title: The Killer Walkthrough Part 1
notes.notes:
[b]Hi, friends![/b] 👋

Welcome to the first part of our thrilling walkthrough for The Killer! Get ready to dive into this spine-chilling game🎮👻


[b]1.Survival Guide[/b]

Trapped in a small room, the sewer seems to be the only way out… One side of the sewer isn’t blocked. Approach the muddy sewer and press “F” to crawl through. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134490/9c61665df36c6b9f15fbd90af5c805ffa4b35a4d.gif[/img]


[b]2.Welcome to Room 2[/b]

There are some buttons on the wall! Press them all and see what happens. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134490/8b03c745d6ae5cb08e83f1c79f48ff732beba471.gif[/img]


[b]3.Trade-Off[/b]

Place the phone📱 on the scale to exchange it for the lever to Room 4.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134490/a1b29d603b93bf918a3aa68592947992b5ad9cd8.gif[/img]


[b]4.Retrace Your Steps[/b]

Follow the sewer back to Room 3, insert the lever to open the sewer leading to Room 4, and enter Room 4🚪. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134490/0bfe017e297fdefc4fa407e6e799a5dd8c4703b3.gif[/img]


[b]5.Unexpected Wealth[/b]

Unfortunately, money 💵 has lost its value in this situation. Pick up a roll of money and place it on the scale to get the lever 2-1 for Room 1.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45134490/180abc517a384b254b625fbc40908635a1475fad.gif[/img]


[b]Enjoy the game![/b] 🎮

If you have any feedback, feel free to reach out to us anytime. 📧
Thank you!
